Cal Hampton est l’ami de Jason et l’asso: Cal Hampton is Jason’s friend and Brian Heder’s associate in the Keys. Rockstar describes him as a man who feels safest at home, where he spends his days monitoring Coast Guard frequencies, with a few beers within reach and some private browsing tabs open. He sees conspiracies everywhere, even in flocks of birds that are a little too well lined up, and wonders whether everything you read online might be true. Happy with his lot in the Keys, he doesn’t share Jason’s ambitions. The official screenshots show him at mini golf, at the pool table and on a float in a pool.
Cal apparaît dans le second trailer aux: Cal appears in Trailer 2 alongside Jason at Brian’s boatyard, in a floral shirt and sunglasses, as a man who’d rather watch than put himself out there.
